checks.detail: The contract re-identified under an enabled recipe.
The underlying must be the canonical asset for this recipe and chain.
Execution requires fresh evidence of at least five deposits by three wallets in 24 hours.
A new entry requires at least 30 days of observed activity.
The live pool or vault must hold at least $100,000 equivalent.
Seven daily share-price or income-index samples must show no daily drop greater than 0.5%.
The exit must succeed in this block and meet its family tolerance.
Protocol pause and freeze flags must permit this operation.
The live cap must admit the amount; factory-verified Vault V2 uses its simulated round trip.
The simulation must match the declared token amounts and reject transfer fees or unexpected outgoing tokens.
Every planned recipe permission must end at zero.
Listing data is separate from the blocking provenance, size, and execution checks.
The live factory or named deployment and required vault listing must be verified.
The wallet must hold enough ETH for the simulated gas, including headroom.
Estimated gas exceeds 1% of the amount.

assertions.detail: Permission after entry must be read and equal zero.
Every outgoing token must be declared by the recipe.
The protocol event must credit the planned wallet and amount.

costEstimate.detail: ASSUMED conservative gas headroom; PayBox and the final transaction receipt determine the actual fee.
